nodes.label: Primary Objectives
nodes.rationale: Optimize for correctness, understanding, technical depth, testing, performance, documentation; presentation last.

nodes.label: Market-Making Bot
nodes.rationale: Earn bid-ask spread while managing inventory; skew quotes when inventory heavy.

nodes.label: Momentum Trader Bot
nodes.rationale: Creates interactions between autonomous participants; need not be profitable.

nodes.label: Random Trader Bot
nodes.rationale: Primarily generates market activity.

nodes.label: API Adapter
nodes.rationale: HTTP/WebSocket adapters only; no matching logic.

nodes.label: Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Visualization only; talks to API; frontend never contains matching logic.

nodes.label: ExchangeLab
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for layout, domain model, matching rules, and data flow; read before any code or API change.

nodes.label: ExchangeLab Product
nodes.rationale: Matching engine is the product; CLI and dashboard are adapters.

nodes.label: Architecture Change Protocol
nodes.rationale: Identify owning module; keep bots/CLI/API → MatchingEngine → OrderBook → trade log; update ARCHITECTURE.md before altering matching rules or public API; run pytest including invalid inputs.

nodes.label: Module Boundaries
nodes.rationale: engine owns matching; strategies own quoting only; simulation owns clock/PnL; api/cli/frontend/benchmarks must not own matching rules.

nodes.label: IndexedOrderBook (v2)
nodes.rationale: SortedDict of FIFO deques plus order_id index; cancel is mark-and-skip; production default.

nodes.label: ListOrderBook (v1)
nodes.rationale: buy_orders/sell_orders lists; best bid/ask via scan; cancel via linear search; constructor default book_version v1 in architecture notes while production default is v2.

nodes.label: OrderBook
nodes.rationale: Per-symbol resting book; bots never write it directly.

nodes.label: Order Cancellation Feature
nodes.rationale: Naive O(n) list scan vs order_id→location hash map; strong interview design decision.

nodes.label: Version 1 Naive Lists
nodes.rationale: Easier to build; best-order scan/sort and O(n) cancel become expensive.

nodes.label: Version 2 Optimized Book
nodes.rationale: price→FIFO queue plus order_id metadata; redesign after profiling cancellation and best-price retrieval.

nodes.label: Throughput Benchmark Results
nodes.rationale: Same 10k/100k workload same trade counts on both books; v2 ~40x–300x faster; cancel 10k resting: v1 8351/s vs v2 34382/s.

nodes.label: v1 List Book
nodes.rationale: Quadratic full-list scan is why v2 exists; v1 aborted at 1M orders after minutes.

nodes.label: v2 Indexed Book
nodes.rationale: Insert O(log P), best bid/ask O(1), cancel locate O(1) with lazy skip; production default for CLI, API, MatchingEngine().

nodes.label: Matching Engine (Plan)
nodes.rationale: Most important component; strong matching engine with ugly CLI preferred over shallow beautiful React backend.

nodes.label: Automated Testing Requirements
nodes.rationale: Tests show the project was engineered rather than assembled.

nodes.label: pytest Suite
nodes.rationale: Coverage: same-side isolation, maker price, FIFO, partials, cancels, market across levels, empty book, invalid qty/price/side/symbol, duplicate IDs, missing cancels.

nodes.label: Price-Time Priority
nodes.rationale: Better price first; equal price is FIFO by arrival; execution at resting maker price.

nodes.label: Frontend After Backend
nodes.rationale: Frontend complexity must not replace backend depth; dashboard after engine works.

nodes.label: Price-Time Priority (Plan)
nodes.rationale: Creates data-structure problem: efficiently retrieve best price while preserving FIFO at same price.

nodes.label: Python-First Language Choice
nodes.rationale: Focus on algorithms, data structures, architecture, testing, correctness; C++ rewrite is extension not requirement.

nodes.label: Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Synthetic load and timing; must not invent alternate matching semantics.

nodes.label: CLI Adapter
nodes.rationale: REPL adapter only; no matching logic.

nodes.label: MatchingEngine
nodes.rationale: Central product API: submit, cancel, book, trades; selects book via book_cls or book_version; matching rules identical across book versions.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.rationale: Prices are decimal.Decimal never floats; quantities positive integers; engine may generate order_id.

nodes.label: Market Order Leftover Not Rested
nodes.rationale: No fills → CANCELLED; some fills then no liquidity → PARTIAL with remaining > 0 not on the book; empty book must not crash.

nodes.label: Self-Trades Allowed (v1)
nodes.rationale: No self-trade prevention in v1; out of scope with persistence, auth, real market data, stops, icebergs, auctions.

nodes.label: Decimal Prices Decision
nodes.rationale: Python first for correctness; Decimal never floats; two books so v1→v2 is a measurable engineering story.

nodes.label: PnL Tracking
nodes.rationale: Tracked in simulation/ not engine: pnl = cash + inventory * mark - starting_cash; mark is mid when spread exists else last trade.

nodes.label: Trading Bots
nodes.rationale: Must call MatchingEngine only; never mutate the book.
